question_text: A training provider stores enrolment records on its network. List three network vulnerabilities that could expose those records.
adaptation_rationale: Narrow generic data-security wording to explicitly listed network vulnerabilities; no unsupported physical/business threats required.
solution: Phishing/credential theft.; Unpatched software vulnerabilities.; SQL injection or malware or weak authentication.

marking_points.criterion: SQL injection or malware or weak authentication.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct wording or valid implementation earning the specified independent points.
partial_credit_notes: Award each stated point independently up to the total; do not double-credit the same idea.

verification.technical: Concrete marking points independently reasoned from the defined context and exact 2027 scope.
verification.code_check: No executable code required; manual technical check.
